name: Bahía Blanca

routes.outcome: Official municipal Catastro page lists parcel/inmueble information, registros gráficos, and parcel-state procedures.
Official municipal information page describes the cadastral/urbanistic report; linked PDF is an instruction document, not a public parcel feature service.
Official municipal bulletin describes SITeBB as led by Departamento Catastro and distinguishes limited public access from restricted expanded inmueble information.
Official municipal map page loads Leaflet/map assets and links to the open-data portal; it is a planning map, not verified parcel geometry.
Official open-government map index loads; no cadastral parcel layer was exposed in the bounded HTML inspection.
Official provincial Carto ARBA landing redirects to the public viewer.
Viewer HTML and current JavaScript/configuration load anonymously. Search routes and map layers are visible, but no credentials were used and no unsafe attribute query was made.
Route exists but rejects the bounded incomplete GET; no parcel request was fabricated and no response was treated as absence.
Municipal chatbot configuration endpoint responds; it is unrelated to cadastral parcel geometry and was not used for parcel data.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Viewer JavaScript uses map projection parameters and EPSG:3857 for some public map objects; no parcel-layer CRS was verified.
schemaAndCrs.viewerConfiguration: Carto ARBA viewer JavaScript/configuration inspected; public search routes include client/getNomencla and client/getPdoPda, but no safe parcel feature response was obtained.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if independently verified

qualification.reason: Local municipal cadastral custody and a public provincial viewer are evidenced, but no bounded anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response or parcel schema was verified.

scopeLimits: The WUP point is a fixed research coordinate, not a parcel-hit requirement.
Municipal SITeBB descriptions establish custody and access boundaries but do not expose a current anonymous parcel API.
The ARBA viewer's map/search routes are not proof of citywide parcel completeness or adapter readiness.
A 405 on an incomplete route is an access/protocol outcome, not evidence of citywide absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, tax/account or personal fields were requested or retained.
uncertainty: Bahía Blanca has evidenced municipal cadastral custody through Departamento de Catastro/SITeBB and a publicly reachable provincial Carto ARBA viewer. Anonymous parcel geometry and stable native identity remain unresolved; serial qualification is required.
